Ask.title: Apply “Like Garuda Linux (Dr460nized)”?
Ask.text:
The look Like Garuda Linux (Dr460nized) will be applied to your desktop.

What will change: colours, window frames, Qt application style, GTK theme, icons, cursors, fonts, wallpaper, panel layout, desktop behaviour.

Rexon builds these parts itself from what your desktop has, close to the original: panel layout, desktop behaviour.

Window effects of this look (wobbly windows, magic lamp, cover switch): Rexon will replace the Marco window manager with Compiz. If Compiz does not start, Marco comes back by itself.

Compiz is built from the AUR: this takes several minutes, and your system will ask for your password.

Covered by the other parts: global theme — in Plasma it is one package of the parts listed here; on this desktop Rexon applies them one by one

Covered by the other parts: desktop shell theme — the MATE panel is drawn by the GTK theme, and the GTK theme of this look is applied

Partly: colours — Qt programs pick it up after you log in again

Partly: Qt application style — Qt programs pick it up after you log in again

Partly: panel layout — the clock sits at the right edge: the MATE panel can't put applets in the middle

Partly: panel layout — the dock does not move out of the way of windows: the MATE panel can only hide automatically

Partly: desktop behaviour — not carried over: maximised windows without title bars — Compiz has no such setting

Partly: desktop behaviour — instead of the desktop name pop-up, Compiz briefly shows its map of desktops when you switch

Rexon will install the programs it needs: qt6ct, kvantum, beautyline, ttf-fira-sans, ttf-firacode-nerd. Your system will ask for your password.

You can put everything back at any time with the “Put Back as It Was” button.

calls: env GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gsettings get org.mate.Marco.general theme
env GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gsettings get org.mate.interface gtk-theme
env GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gsettings get org.mate.interface icon-theme
env GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gsettings get org.mate.peripherals-mouse cursor-theme
env GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gsettings get org.mate.interface font-name
gsettings set org.mate.interface font-name Fira Sans 10

sh -c mkdir -p "$(dirname "$2")" && dconf dump /org/mate/panel/ > "$2" && mate-panel --layout "$1" --reset sh $HOME/.local/share/mate-panel/layouts/rexon-garuda-dr460nized.layout $HOME/.config/rexon/looks/garuda-dr460nized/mate-panel.dconf
env GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gsettings get org.mate.Marco.general compositing-manager
env GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gsettings get org.mate.Marco.general button-layout

sh -c u=$(id -u); setsid -f compiz --replace ccp >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; i=0; while [ $i -lt 12 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); pgrep -u "$u" -x compiz >/dev/null || break; done; if pgrep -u "$u" -x compiz >/dev/null && pgrep -u "$u" -x gtk-window-deco >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; setsid -f marco --replace >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; exit 1
env GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gsettings get org.mate.session.required-components windowmanager

profile..config/compiz-1/compizconfig/Rexon.ini:
[core]
s0_active_plugins = core;composite;opengl;decor;resize;place;move;mousepoll;compiztoolbox;regex;text;session;workarounds;wobbly;animation;fade;shift;wall;

[decor]
s0_command = gtk-window-decorator

[animation]
s0_minimize_effects = animation:Magic Lamp;
s0_unminimize_effects = animation:Magic Lamp;

[shift]
s0_mode = 0
s0_next_key = <Alt>Tab
s0_prev_key = <Shift><Alt>Tab

[wall]
